zh: **关闭「聊天区滚动动画」后，进行中的状态行留在文档里**：此时滚动整份交回宿主，这一行不再停在输入框上方，读者往回翻看时它随内容一起滚走。
en: **With the chat-area scrolling animation off, the running status line keeps its document place**: the host owns the scroll then, so the line no longer rests above the composer and wheels away with the content as you read back.
